nodes.title: ZX Bank offers convenient access to its digital banking services in Bhutan through a network of ATM locations. Below are the details of our available ATMs across the country (*dummy addresses for representative purposes*).
nodes.summary: ZX Bank has 15 ATM locations across 11 cities and towns in Bhutan: Thimphu (2 ATMs), Paro (2 ATMs), Punakha, Phuentsholing (2 ATMs), Wangdue, Bumthang, Samdrup Jongkhar, Trongsa, Trashigang, Mongar, Gelephu, and Haa. Each entry lists the location/branch name and address.

nodes.title: Total ZX Bank ATMs in Bhutan: 15
nodes.summary: All ZX Bank ATMs in Bhutan offer 24/7 cash withdrawal, balance inquiry, mini-statement printing, and cardless QR withdrawals via the ZX Bank Asia app. For the latest information visit www.zxbank.asia.
